caption: A lava lamp that has warmed up glows on a table, and the blobs of wax inside rise and sink.

sa.check: A lava lamp glows on a table.
Blobs of wax rise inside it.
The blobs rise from the lamp's base.
The blobs slow near the top.

pc.expect: The blobs rise from the warm base, slow near the top and fall again, moving up and down through the liquid.
pc.fail: The blobs all sink to the base and stay there while the lamp glows; or the blobs gather at the top and stay; or a blob hangs motionless in mid-liquid for the rest of the clip; or the blobs rise from the top and sink to the base.

pc.expect: The blobs move only with the slow currents in the lamp and their paths are gentle.
pc.fail: A blob shoots across the lamp sideways; or a blob spins fast on the spot; or the blobs arrange themselves into a pattern; or the blobs move in a rhythm unrelated to the base, jumping while the base is dark.

pc.expect: The rising and sinking runs as a slow cycle: a blob that has risen comes down and one that has fallen goes up, and the wax stays wax.
pc.fail: A blob vanishes at the top and reappears at the base; or the wax sets into a solid lump while the lamp glows; or every blob freezes in place while the lamp still glows; or the blobs freeze and melt in turn.

pc.expect: The blobs are soft rounded lumps that stretch, pinch off and merge, and the liquid around them is clear and thin.
pc.fail: A blob keeps a sharp-cornered shape as it rises; or two blobs touch and pass through each other without merging or parting; or the blobs shatter; or the liquid moves as a solid mass with the blobs fixed in it.

pc.expect: One lamp; the wax stays inside the glass and the blobs merge or split rather than appearing or vanishing.
pc.fail: A blob appears from nowhere in the middle of the liquid; or a blob vanishes in mid-liquid; or wax passes through the glass; or a second lamp appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The lamp's base, its cap and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The lamp's base changes colour; or the wax changes colour; or items on the table rearrange.
